learn.title: Learn
learn.subtitle: Build Your Data Science and AI Skills with WiDS
learn.description: WiDS is committed to inspiring, educating, and supporting data scientists around the world. WiDS programs consist of exciting Datathon challenges, in-depth upskilling workshops, and resources for educators from secondary schools to graduate studies.
learn.datathon-description: The WiDS Datathon is an opportunity to discover and hone data science skills while solving an interesting and critical social impact challenge.
learn.nextgen-description: Education outreach program promoting careers in data science, AI, and related fields for secondary school students.

blog.description: Discover inspiring stories, insights, and news from the world of women in data science. Stay updated with articles, interviews, and highlights from our community on the WiDS Blog.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: About us
about.description: WiDS Guayaquil @ ESPOL is an independent event organized by Ph.D. Carmen Vaca, based at the Escuela Superior Politécnica del Litoral (ESPOL). This event coincides with the annual global Women in Data Science (WiDS) conference, held by Stanford University with over 150 locations around the world. Everyone is invited to attend the regional WiDS events, which feature outstanding women doing exceptional work.
